scope: 117 verified body layouts, 189 blue/red/tech variants; narrative fields where available
method: Registered-limit CJK pressure fill plus separately expanded source-length pressure; PowerPoint TextRange bounds audit, 3 pt tolerance
limitations: Pressure copy is synthetic; native text fields and design balance still need visual review.
Source-only fallback trials do not prove integrated fill works with those fields.
Expanded-copy tests are physical fit probes; they do not widen bindings automatically.
Some target fields have source examples longer than today's registered safe limits; those layouts need per-field remediation.
Only narrative fields or the longest explanatory label were stressed; headings, chart values, and decorative text are outside this scope.
